topic: Part 5 Test 4 (SAA African Cell Field Strength) — EXP-609 PRED-073 cross-reference paragraph + TLDR refresh
our_argument_summary: Test 4 argues the dome SAA field-strength prediction is non-discriminating (extrapolated from CHAOS-7 globe data). EXP-609 appended one paragraph showing the dome ALSO registered exactly one genuinely discriminating SAA claim (PRED-073, >=0.3deg/month western-cell drift), which falsified on the dome's own rule (window closed 2026-05-31, dome silent) and was never scored — pre-empting the defender objection that the dome does make risky SAA predictions. TLDR refreshed to carry the PRED-073 punchline.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: Dome-side: no result posted for PRED-073 in status_history.json or page text since window close (poller heartbeat chg-20260610-0008-001, d=10). The dome scoreboard does not score this prediction — which is precisely the paragraph's point.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: The Test 4 field-strength prediction extrapolates CHAOS-7 (globe) data and relabels mechanism as aetheric field stress — unchanged by EXP-609. PRED-073 itself was NOT a relabel (it diverged 12-13x from the standard rate) — that is what made it discriminating, falsifiable, and falsified.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: PRED-073 was genuinely prospective: registered 2026-04-04, window April-May 2026 (predictions.json:PRED-073 is_genuinely_prospective=true). The paragraph credits this explicitly — correct and consistent with our catalog.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: The >=0.3deg/month figure is asserted from 'toroidal aetheric return flow' with no traceable derivation from dome geometry parameters; the field-strength prediction derives from CHAOS-7 observational data, not dome geometry.

holes_found.description: Phrase 'hash-committed before the window' implicitly credits the SHA hash as the prospectivity evidence. Our own Timestamp Error analysis argues content hashes prove integrity, not temporal priority — prospectivity here actually rests on the registration date (2026-04-04) plus window timing, which our catalog independently records. A careful reader could note we apply hash-skepticism inconsistently.
holes_found.recommendation: At next touch, reword to 'registered before the window opened (and hash-committed)' or similar — keep the credit, move the evidentiary weight to the registration date.

holes_found.description: 'The dome registered exactly one SAA claim that genuinely diverged from standard physics' is accurate on the current catalog (9 other SAA entries are recycled/standard_physics/unfalsifiable/trend-extrapolation), but PRED-R001 (separation >=57deg by 2030, genuinely prospective, pending through 2030) is a live SAA claim whose discriminating status is not finally adjudicated. 'Exactly one' is a hostage to that future call.
holes_found.recommendation: Low-urgency: consider 'exactly one SAA claim to date' or note the PRED-R001 adjudication dependency in the EXP record. No change required while PRED-R001 remains assessed as trend-extrapolation.

holes_found.description: 'the entry still sits as pending on its own predictions page' is an undated present-tense claim. Verified current (poller heartbeat 2026-06-10, d=10 past close), but if the dome later posts a result the sentence goes stale silently in static prose; 6.15 is the canonical live tracker.
holes_found.recommendation: At next touch, add an as-of date ('as of June 2026') or rely on the 6.15 cross-link for currency. Poller heartbeat coverage mitigates — any dome-side change will be detected and should trigger re-edit.

stronger_arguments.description: The juxtaposition could be sharpened one notch: the dome SILENT-IGNORED a prediction it hash-committed — the integrity theater (hashing) and the scoreboard theater (never scoring misses) are the same behavior pattern. One clause linking to the Timestamp Error tab would unify the two critiques.

kernel_of_truth.description: The EXP-609 paragraph already carries the kernel correctly: PRED-073 was the dome's most honest SAA artifact — genuinely prospective (registration 2026-04-04 precedes the April-May window, predictions.json:PRED-073), with an explicit numeric falsification rule (<0.1deg or reversal), and the drift DIRECTION matches both observation and the dome mechanism narrative (predictions.json:PRED-073 kernel_of_truth field).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Direction-match without magnitude-match is not predictive power: the committed magnitude (>=0.3deg/month = ~3.65deg/yr) is 12-13x the measured 0.282+/-0.030 deg/yr western-cell rate (Finlay et al. 2020, doi:10.1186/s40623-020-01252-9), so the standard-physics expectation (~0.024deg/month) itself triggers the dome's own <0.1deg falsification rule (predictions.json:PRED-073 verdict_notes). And the dome never scored the miss (chg-20260610-0008-001).
